notes.title: Major Update! Cassius' new route, Achievements and more!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Yonder World: Interview with the Void just received its next major update! Several features are implemented into the game, including:

[list]
[*] A new branch to Cassius' story
[*] 2 new CG's
[*] 12 Steam achievements
[*] Ending tracker
[*] New endings and Death flags!
[/list]

Cassius' story has now been expanded after Day 15 in the Yonder. A demon trapped [spoiler]in his own cycle of self-hatred and loneliness despite his outward playfulness,[/spoiler] is the Yonder the place for him to be? Or are you going to make a choice for him, a choice to open up more doors ahead of Cassius?

The game is now over 250,000 words long, heavily story and narrative-driven. with 35 endings counting death flags and 15 gorgeous CGs for you to explore! We have also added an Achievement system exclusive to the Steam version of the game!  

An Ending tracker is now added to the game per popular request. As we did not plan to add this feature before this update, while the game still remember your previous progress, including your unlocked CG's and endings, the tracker will NOT display the endings acquired prior to the update. We sincerely apologise to any inconveniences! 

Likewise, some achievements won't appear until you hit the requirements again. Some collective achivements will appear as soon as the first requirement is acquired.

We will be updating the official guide to achieve Cassius' new routes and endings soon, as well as streamlining the existing guide.

If there is no other changes to our plans, this will be the last major update for Yonder World! 

Thank you all so much and enjoy your stay in the Yonder!


With love,

Fluttering Abyss

notes.title: Demo Update! Full Arc 1 incorporated!
notes.notes:
Welcome back to the Yonder!

We're here with a final [b]major[/b] update to Yonder World's Demo! All changes are applied to our Win, Mac and Linux versions.  

[b]Demo update (Version 2.7):[/b]

[list]
[*] Full first 15 days of the game are now available 
[*] Updated GUI
[*] New CG's added
[*] New character encounters
[*] New items & food 
[*] Character affection meters added (Platonic & Romantic)
[/list]

If you follow us on Twitter, you might have noticed that [url=https://twitter.com/FlutteringAbyss/status/1518016765191757824]we recently announced our voice actors[/url]. Their performances will be included in the demo on a minor future update, along with achivements implementation!

The first 15 days of [i]Yonder World: Interview with the Void[/i] are meant for our MC to understand the strange world she was sucked into a little more, getting acquainted with the strange people who frequent the Yonder, deciding whether she should get closer to any of them or help herself out of this mess (or die, depending on your choices ːsteamsaltyː). 

Yonder World offers both Platonic and Romantic options for the player, with a diverse cast of love interests. The supporting characters are there to either help you along the way, or lure you into options that you may regret later down the line. Our MC is designed to have drastic character growth, a moderate change as you go along with the storyline, or stay completely the same as the game begins,... all by your decision.

The full game is scheduled to be released on June 22nd, 2022! We hope you will enjoy your stay in the Yonder, and come back for more when time comes!

With love,
Fluttering Abyss

notes.title: Demo Update! New Days Available in the Yonder!
notes.notes:
Welcome back to the Yonder!

Thanks to how well our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/flutteringabyss/yonder-world-interview-with-the-void]Kickstarter[/url] has been doing (and to all our backers), we can now release an updated version of our existing Demo!

[b]Demo update (Version 2.0):[/b]

[list]
[*] 5 more possible endings (to the demo). 
[*] 2 new days.
[*] First meeting with Aksan.
[*] New available item.
[*] New BG.
[*] New mystery character!
[*] Existing save bug fixed.
[*] Credits edited.
[/list]

Let's talk a bit more about the game's final version, shall we?[b] Yonder World[/b] is a sprawling story with hugely diverging routes, depending on how you interact with each character, but also depending on how you choose to make the protagonist grow. Our MC is designed to have drastic character growth, a moderate change as you go along with the storyline, or stay completely the same as the game begins,... all by your decision. 

We aim to offer something for everyone, and there are even options for when you don't want to romance any character but still want a good ending! We want the game to be as inclusive as possible, and hope that you all will enjoy your stay in the Yonder!

If you've enjoyed the game's contents so far, please consider supporting our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/flutteringabyss/yonder-world-interview-with-the-void]Kickstarter campaign[/url] to help bring the full game to life!

Yonder World has achieved 57% backings on Kickstarter in under two weeks, receiving over £4000 in amount backed and over 80 backers!
